_note: Section 13.6 of the Deaf Sports unit document, as data for the evidence tracker builder. One entry per ACARA checklist row. Challenge uses Y3 and Y4; Enrichment uses Y5 and Y6.

Y3.1.consolidating: Gives two facts about a person on a card
Y3.1.proficient: Gives two facts and answers a question about them

Y3.2.consolidating: Uses the question face on one question
Y3.2.proficient: Question face on every question, and waits for the answer

Y3.3.emerging: Both people in the same space
Y3.3.proficient: Two people placed and kept there for two events

Y3.4.evidence: Piece 2 item 10 and the Do Now books
Y3.4.consolidating: Underlines the words that need a sign
Y3.4.proficient: Underlines them and names one word English has that Auslan does not sign

Y3.5.emerging: Says Auslan and English are the same
Y3.5.consolidating: Notices one word English has that Auslan does not sign
Y3.5.proficient: Names one difference and gives an example

Y4.1.consolidating: Asks two questions from the card
Y4.1.proficient: Asks two questions and answers two, without the card

Y4.2.consolidating: Uses a depicting sign or the face for one event
Y4.2.proficient: Uses placement, face and depicting signs across the retell

Y4.3.emerging: Reads the strip aloud in English
Y4.3.consolidating: Signs the four events in order
Y4.3.proficient: Signs them in order with a time sign joining two

Y4.4.consolidating: Waves and waits most of the time
Y4.4.proficient: Waves or taps and waits for eyes every time, and says why

Y4.5.consolidating: Says Auslan belongs to a community
Y4.5.proficient: Gives an example of Deaf people deciding something for themselves

Y5.1.emerging: Waits to be told what to do in the game and the interview
Y5.1.consolidating: Runs the interview with the prompt card face up
Y5.1.proficient: Runs it card face down and keeps the exchange alive through a breakdown

Y5.2.emerging: Signs the four events with no scene set
Y5.2.consolidating: Sets the scene, then loses the two swimmers into one space
Y5.2.proficient: Scene first, both swimmers held in separate places for the whole retell

Y5.3.consolidating: Uses placement for one of the two people
Y5.3.proficient: Placement, face and depicting signs all carry meaning in the retell

Y5.4.evidence: Piece 2, item 10 and the Do Now books
Y5.4.emerging: Signs the English words in the English order
Y5.4.consolidating: Finds the four events and signs them in order
Y5.4.proficient: Reorders where Auslan needs it and can say why

Y5.5.emerging: Names a fact about Deaf sport
Y5.5.consolidating: Names a fact and says what it meant for Deaf people
Y5.5.proficient: Connects a change in the sport to the community that made it

Y6.1.consolidating: Four turns from the card, eyes leaving between questions
Y6.1.proficient: Four turns plus a follow-up of their own, eyes held throughout

Y6.2.emerging: Delivers the four facts as a list
Y6.2.consolidating: Four facts in the fixed order
Y6.2.proficient: Four facts in order, with DS, CA and NMFs carrying part of the meaning

Y6.3.evidence: Piece 2 item 10 only. Partly covered: audience and context are barely touched, so a Consolidating ceiling is honest this term
Y6.3.emerging: Word for word from the page
Y6.3.proficient: Meaning carried and one reordering they can explain

Y6.4.consolidating: Names a barrier and the thing that was redesigned
Y6.4.proficient: Generalises to a barrier outside sport and says what would change

Y6.5.consolidating: Explains that Auslan belongs to a community
Y6.5.proficient: Explains why a community having its own language matters
